notes.title: 5 Year Anniversary: The Collection Update
notes.notes:
5 years huh? Didn't think I'd make it here. But regardless here we are, and with a brand new update!!!





This fun lil redo of the original keeps the Techpack you know and love, and adds in the pathway for

so many new games! In this update you'll find many features are locked, not to worry! I'll be rolling out many small-time updates fixing the many bugs and adding/improving features as I go along. Have fun and

get those high scores!

notes.title: TECHPACK 3 Year Anniversary Update
notes.notes: Three years huh? Well, after three years of absence, I’ve finally been able to release this brand new update, revamping the game, art and music (depending on your view of a revamp). Thank you all for playing! Look forward to many more arcade games to be added to this project. All selectable from this one Steam game!
